messages.text:
The current failure is not in rendering; it’s in the metadata used for sorting synthetic `.` and `..` entries.

Rust creates those entries as directories but their size ordering differs from normal child directories, so I’m checking the source boundary and then correcting the sort metadata model.

commands.commandLine: rg -n "fn length|pub fn length|fn size\(|pub fn size\(|recursive_size" rust-reference/src/fs/file.rs
